title: Meerkats Platform Dictionary v1 — contract for platform_heuristics/<platform>/dictionary.json
description: One platform's metric vocabulary and display traps: native UI labels, formulas, API fields, attribution bases, and the traps that make numbers lie. Name authority rule stands: metric NAMES and FORMULAS for computation belong to the semantic layer (catalog/MetricFlow); this file holds PLATFORM semantics only — a term's optional `registry` key points at the semantic-layer name it computes through. Term entries are hand-authored knowledge, so the contract enforces shape, not content: a term is an object of string facts, a plain string note, or a list of open items. Keys starting with _ are mirror metadata (ci/mirror.py) and always allowed. The competition pack's dictionary is a different artifact (acquisition spec) and is outside this contract.

oneOf.description: a term's facts: ui_label, status (native|jargon|structural), formula, api, registry, basis, trap, surfaces, note — all string-valued
